requirements.text: The game window should be titled "Flappy Bird Clone".
requirements.check: The game window title bar displays "Flappy Bird Clone".
requirements.quote: Create a one-screen side-scrolling game called "Flappy Bird Clone".

requirements.text: A small bird asset is displayed at a fixed horizontal position near the left of the window.
requirements.check: A bird sprite is visible on screen, not moving horizontally, and positioned near the left edge.
requirements.quote: A small bird stays at a fixed horizontal position near the left of the window

requirements.text: The bird falls downward under constant gravity.
requirements.check: Without input, the bird's vertical position (y-coordinate) continuously increases.
requirements.quote: and falls downward under constant gravity.

requirements.text: Pressing the Space key gives the bird an instant upward burst of velocity.
requirements.check: Pressing Space causes the bird's vertical velocity to become negative (upward) instantly.
requirements.quote: Pressing Space gives the bird an upward flap, a single instant upward burst of velocity

requirements.text: Releasing the Space key does nothing.
requirements.check: Releasing Space has no immediate effect on the bird's velocity or position.
requirements.quote: releasing Space does nothing.

requirements.text: Pipes with a gap in the middle scroll in from the right edge of the screen toward the left at a constant speed.
requirements.check: Pipe segments appear on the right edge and move horizontally to the left at a steady rate.
requirements.quote: Pipes with a gap in the middle scroll in from the right edge of the screen toward the left at a constant speed

requirements.text: A new pipe appears at a regular time interval.
requirements.check: New pipe pairs (top and bottom) are generated and start scrolling from the right at consistent time intervals.
requirements.quote: with a new pipe appearing at a regular time interval

requirements.text: Each new pipe has a random gap height.
requirements.check: Successive pipe pairs have their gaps positioned at different vertical locations.
requirements.quote: and a new random gap height each time.

requirements.text: Passing through a pipe's gap without touching a pipe adds 1 point to the score.
requirements.check: When the bird's horizontal position passes the gap of a pipe without collision, the score increases by 1.
requirements.quote: Passing through a pipe's gap without touching a pipe adds 1 point.

requirements.text: Touching any pipe ends the game.
requirements.check: If the bird's bounding box overlaps with any pipe segment, the game state changes to 'game over'.
requirements.quote: Touching any pipe, or the bird touching the top or bottom edge of the screen, ends the game.

requirements.text: The bird touching the top or bottom edge of the screen ends the game.
requirements.check: If the bird's vertical position goes above the top edge or below the bottom edge of the screen, the game state changes to 'game over'.
requirements.quote: Touching any pipe, or the bird touching the top or bottom edge of the screen, ends the game.

requirements.text: The background should be a plain sky-blue colour.
requirements.check: The game window background is a solid sky-blue color.
requirements.quote: Use a plain sky-blue background colour instead of a background image.

requirements.text: The current score is shown in the top-left corner at all times.
requirements.check: A numerical score display is continuously visible in the top-left corner of the screen.
requirements.quote: Show the current score in the top-left corner at all times.

requirements.text: When the game is over, "GAME OVER" and the final score are displayed.
requirements.check: Upon game over, the text "GAME OVER" appears on screen, along with the score achieved.
requirements.quote: When the game is over, show GAME OVER and the final score

requirements.text: When the game is over, pipes and the bird stop moving.
requirements.check: After game over, the bird's position and all pipe positions remain static.
requirements.quote: and stop moving the pipes and the bird.

requirements.text: Pressing R restarts the game with score 0, the bird at its starting position, and all pipes cleared.
requirements.check: After pressing R during game over, the score resets to 0, the bird is at its initial position, and no pipes are on screen.
requirements.quote: Press R to restart with score 0, the bird back at its starting position, and all pipes cleared.

requirements.text: Pressing Escape quits the game.
requirements.check: Pressing Escape closes the game window.
requirements.quote: Press Escape to quit.

requirements.text: Print "FLAP" to the console every time Space is pressed.
requirements.check: When Space is pressed, "FLAP" is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: FLAP

requirements.text: Print "RESTART" to the console every time R is pressed.
requirements.check: When R is pressed, "RESTART" is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: RESTART

requirements.text: Print "QUIT" to the console every time Escape is pressed.
requirements.check: When Escape is pressed, "QUIT" is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: QUIT

requirements.text: Print "GAME OVER" to the console when the game ends.
requirements.check: When the game ends, "GAME OVER" is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: and print GAME OVER when the game ends.

requirements.text: The game should have no sounds.
requirements.check: No audio output is produced by the game.
requirements.quote: No sounds.

files.purpose: Marks the game directory as a Python package.
Main game logic, initialization, game loop, event handling, and rendering.

assets.strategy_rationale: The spec explicitly requests two small image assets for the bird and pipe segment.

sprites.description: A small, cartoonish bird, yellow with small wings, in pixel art style.
A green pipe segment, pixel art style, suitable for stacking to form pipes.

architecture.test_input_example: Hold SPACE for 10 frames, release, wait 100 frames, press SPACE, wait 100 frames, press R, press ESCAPE.
